# EduSync
EduSync is a school management platform for teachers, coordinators, students, and families in Paraná, Brazil.

## Public pages
- https://edusync.com.br/login/
- https://edusync.com.br/alunos/
- https://edusync.com.br/pedagogico-portal/
- https://edusync.com.br/privacidade/
- https://edusync.com.br/termos/
- https://edusync.com.br/qrcode/
- https://edusync.com.br/video/

## Avoid
- Internal application pages under /pages/
- Tokenized or user-specific URLs unless explicitly intended for public citation
